messages:
Ivy Chen: Heads-up 1: customer POC stalled because CPQ routed a 8-month commit with a negotiated discount to Sales Ops instead of Deal Desk. We need clearer approval routing.
Owen Park: Which CPQ flags are we using now?
Ivy Chen: Right now it only checks `Price_Exception__c` (bool). No commit length or ARR thresholds.
Rina Kapoor: That's the gap. Suggest compute `DealDesk_Flag__c` in CPQ with logic: Commit_Months__c >= 6 OR Discount_Percent__c > 15 OR Legal_Terms_Requested__c = TRUE => route to Deal Desk.
Owen Park: Also populate `DealDesk_Reason__c` values: commit-length, discount-threshold, legal-term, security-qa, manual-override. Makes queue filters easy.
Ivy Chen: Sales needs a hard SLA to promise to customers. Propose `Approval_SLA_Hours__c` set by CPQ: <=50k ARR -> 24, 50k-250k -> 48, >250k or legal changes -> 72.
Rina Kapoor: Add `SLA_Expires_At__c` timestamp and `Auto_Escalated__c` boolean so the system can escalate to Deal Desk lead when overdue. Also include `Suggested_Template_Id__c` for Legal to preload NDA/SOW.
Owen Park: Small implementation note: compute flag in CPQ and keep routing logic out of the queue service. Queue reads `DealDesk_Flag__c` + `DealDesk_Reason__c`. Easier to test.
Ivy Chen: Can someone drop a SOQL to validate in sandbox?
Owen Park: ```sql
SELECT Id, Name, Commit_Months__c, Discount_Percent__c, DealDesk_Flag__c, DealDesk_Reason__c, Approval_SLA_Hours__c, SLA_Expires_At__c FROM Opportunity WHERE Id = 'OPP-3003'
```
Rina Kapoor: I'll open a ticket for CPQ changes and add test cases. Please include playbook text for Sales so they can quote SLAs to customers.
deal-bot: created ticket DD-1520 for CPQ routing + SLA fields (owner: @Rina Kapoor) 1: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/DD-1520
Ivy Chen: Thanks. Action items: Rina -> ticket & sandbox patch; Owen -> SOQLs + test vectors; I'll coordinate stakeholder signoff after sandbox verification.
Rina Kapoor: Will post sandbox test outputs and a draft playbook blurb in this thread. :thumbsup:
